official.description: The International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) - Fall is a Toronto Metropolitan University entrance scholarship for undergraduate international students enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time, recognising students who do well academically, volunteer, join clubs and show leadership qualities; it has a value of $10,000 CAD with up to 53 recipients for fall 2027 and is entrance-only and non-renewable.

applicant_utility.summary: ISLA - Fall pays a flat $10,000 CAD once, in your first year only, and TMU rewards exactly the profile the award names: strong grades (86%+ final admission average) plus documented volunteering, club membership and leadership. You can apply before you even hold an admission offer, as long as you have activated your TMU student identity for AwardSpring, which makes this one of the few entrance awards worth completing in November rather than after admission decisions land. The personal statement is the only differentiator among hundreds of 86%+ applicants, so treat it as the real application, and never leave submission to the final evening - TMU states no late applications are accepted under any circumstances, technical difficulties included.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international undergraduates with a final admission average of 86% or better who can point to a concrete record of volunteering, clubs and leadership.
application_readiness_checklist: Activate your TMU online identity and confirm you can log in to torontomu.awardspring.ca before the 2 November 2026 opening
Finalise the personal statement in October - the window is 2 November 2026 to 16 February 2027 but early submission avoids portal issues
Verify your final admission average meets 86%, an A, or the equivalent for your curriculum
Confirm you have not previously attended a Canadian post-secondary institution full-time, and that any gap year is one academic year or shorter
Watch your email and the ChooseTMU Applicant Portal for decision and follow-up notifications
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 11:59 p.m. ET cut-off on 16 February 2027 - TMU explicitly excludes technical-difficulty excuses
A generic personal statement that lists activities without evidence of leadership impact
A final admission average below 86% (or below an A-equivalent)
Prior full-time study at a Canadian post-secondary institution, which breaks the first-year rule
Confusing ISLA - Fall with ISLA - Winter, whose deadline (14 September 2026) had already passed and which has its own separate application
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The $10,000 is a one-off cash award against international tuition at TMU, which is far larger; the remaining tuition balance, living costs in Toronto, housing, health insurance and travel all remain your responsibility, and the award does not renew in later years.
document_audit: You need a TMU Student Number and activated online identity before AwardSpring will let you apply - request this well before 2 November 2026
The application is a two-step process on AwardSpring: a general application first, then the ISLA follow-up including the personal statement
Keep evidence of your volunteering and leadership roles ready so statement claims are specific and verifiable
alerts: The fall 2027 window only opens on 2 November 2026 - applications cannot be submitted earlier
ISLA - Winter is a different award with a different (earlier) deadline; do not rely on the fall deadline information for January starters
As a non-renewable entrance award, plan your full four-year funding before accepting - this money covers only year one
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Obtain a TMU Student Number, activate the online identity, complete the AwardSpring general application and the ISLA follow-up with personal statement between 2 November 2026 and 16 February 2027, then monitor email and the ChooseTMU Applicant Portal for the decision.
